description: Generated deepcopy functions for Kubernetes custom resource types in package v1, including types like ClusterTestType and TestType, with methods for deep copying and object interface implementation.

methods.name: DeepCopyInto
methods.description: Copies receiver into out, used for deep copying of resource objects.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a new deep copy of the receiver object.

methods.name: DeepCopyObject
methods.description: Returns a deep copy of the object as runtime.Object interface.
